countingUnit: measure switch: points (แห่ง, default; the option names what is counted: หน่วยงานและสถานที่ · หน่วยงาน · สถานที่) or personnel recorded (คน; government offices with unknown personnel counted apart, never 0; personnel once per office and per local government; an agency's whole workforce on its head office only; places have none); off for a scope without recorded personnel
